anemic: Anémie: no blood. An anemic recovery.
anodyne: An + odyne: no pain. An anodyne speech.
artlessness: Art + less: simplicity. The artlessness of a child.
bowdlerize: Dr Bowdler cleaned Shakespeare. Bowdlerize a book.
derelict: De + relinquere: left behind. A derelict building.
duplicity: Duplex: double. Duplicity in the contract.
effrontery: Effronté: shameless. Effrontery to demand more.
enjoin: Enjoindre: order. The court enjoined the sale.
enthrall: Thrall: slave. Enthralled by the story.
epiphany: Epiphaneia: appearing. An epiphany in the shower.
flummox: Slang: confuse. Flummoxed by the puzzle.
gaffe: Gaffe: a blunder. A diplomatic gaffe.
grandiloquent: Grandis + loqui: grand speech. A grandiloquent speech.
hagiographic: Hagios + graphein: saints’ lives. A hagiographic biography.
hail: Hail: greet. Hailed as a hero.
insouciance: In + souci: no care. A French insouciance.
lampoon: Lampons! Let’s drink. A lampoon in the press.
litany: Litaneia: prayer. A litany of complaints.
perspicacious: Per + specere: see through. A perspicacious judge.
primacy: Primus: first. The primacy of health.
prolixity: Prolix: long-winded. Prolixity in the report.
provident: Pro + videre: see ahead. A provident saver.
quail: Quail: cower. Quail before the dragon.
raconteur: Raconter: tell. A raconteur at dinner.
recapitulation: Re + caput: head again. Recapitulation of the facts.
semblance: Sembler: seem. A semblance of order.
sinecure: Sine + cura: no care. A sinecure on the board.
solecism: Soloi: faulty Greek. A solecism of grammar.
temerity: Temeritas: rashness. The temerity to ask.
umbrage: Umbra: shadow. Take umbrage at a remark.
unforthcoming: Not forthcoming: reluctant to share. An unforthcoming witness.
